Belonging to the mouth or face. --स्यं [अस्यते ग्रासोऽत्र, अस्ण्यत्] 1 The mouth, jaws; आस्यकुहरे, विवृतास्यः. --2 Face; आस्यकमलं. --3 A part of the mouth used in pronouncing letters; तुल्यास्यप्रयत्नं सवर्णं P. I. 1. 9; आस्ये भवमास्यं ताल्वादिस्थानं Sk.; षडास्यानि Pt. 5. 55; (the six parts being the throat, head or brain palate, tooth, lip, and nose). --4 Mouth, opening; व्रणास्यं, अंकास्यं &c. --Comp. --आसवः spittle, saliva. --पत्रं a lotus. --लांगलः {1} a dog. {2} a boar. --लोमन् n. beard.
आस्यंधय: आस्यंधय a. [आस्यं धयति धे-ख मुम्] Kissing.
आस्र: आस्रं [अस्रमेव स्वार्थेऽण्] Blood. --Comp. --पः {1} ‘blood-drinker’, demon. {2} the 19th lunar mansion.
आस्रं: आस्रं [अस्रमेव स्वार्थेऽण्] Blood. --Comp. --पः {1} ‘blood-drinker’, demon. {2} the 19th lunar mansion.
आस्रव: आस्रवः [आस्रु-अप्] 1 Pain, affliction, distress. --2 Flowing, running. --3 Discharge, emission. --4 Fault, transgression. --5 The foam on boiling rice. --6 (With Jainas) The impulse called योग or attention which the soul participates in the movement of its various bodies; it is defined as the ‘action of the senses which impels the soul towards external objects’; it is good or evil according as it is directed towards good or evil objects.
आस्रवः: आस्रवः [आस्रु-अप्] 1 Pain, affliction, distress. --2 Flowing, running. --3 Discharge, emission. --4 Fault, transgression. --5 The foam on boiling rice. --6 (With Jainas) The impulse called योग or attention which the soul participates in the movement of its various bodies; it is defined as the ‘action of the senses which impels the soul towards external objects’; it is good or evil according as it is directed towards good or evil objects.
आस्राव: आस्राव a. Flowing, running. --वः 1 A wound. --2 Flow, issue, discharge. --3 Spittle, saliva. --4 Pain, affliction. --5 A disease of the body. --Comp. --भेषजं medicament, medicine.
आस्राविन्: आस्राविन् a. Flowing, emitting fluid or humour; an epithet of the elephant when ichor is issuing from its temples.
आस्वद्: आस्वद् {c1c} A. To taste. --Caus. To taste, enjoy; संभोगं Me. 87; R. 3. 54; (fig.) to plunder, defraud; नास्वाद्यसे भुजंगैः K. 109.
आस्वाद: आस्वाद a. Tasting, eating. --दः 1 Tasting, eating; चूतांकुरास्वादकषायकंठः Ku. 3. 32; काव्यामृतरसास्वादः H. 1. 152; मूखास्वादः Y. 3. 229 kissing. --2 Relish, flavour, taste; ज्ञातास्वादो विवृतजघनां को विहातुं समर्थः Me. 41; सुखास्वादपरः H. 4. 76; चित्रास्वादकथैर्भृत्यैः Pt. 1. --3 Enjoying, experiencing; °वत् a. delicious in flavour, palatable; आस्वादवद्भिः कवलैस्तृणानां R. 2. 5.
आस्वाद्य: आस्वाद्य pot. p. To be tasted, delicious, sweet, palatable.
आह: आह ind. 1 An interjection showing (a) reproof; (b) severity; (c) command; (d) casting, sending. --2 An irregular verbal form of the 3rd. pers. sing. Pres. of a defective verb meaning ‘to say,’ or ‘to speak’ (supposed by Indian grammarians to be derived from ब्रू and by European scholars from अह्; the only forms of the root existing in the language are:-- आत्थ, आहथुः, आह, आहतुः, and आहुः).
आहक: आहकः [आ-हण्-ड-कन्] A peculiar disease of the nose; तनुना रक्तशोथेन युक्तो नासापुटांतरे । गात्रशूलज्वरकरः श्लेष्मणा ह्याहको ज्वरः ॥.
आहकः: आहकः [आ-हण्-ड-कन्] A peculiar disease of the nose; तनुना रक्तशोथेन युक्तो नासापुटांतरे । गात्रशूलज्वरकरः श्लेष्मणा ह्याहको ज्वरः ॥.
आहन्: आहन् {c2c} P. 1 To strike, hit, beat; कुट्टिममाजघान K. 10; परस्य शिर आहंति Sk.; Śi. 7. 17; दुर्जयान् करिणः … आहन्यात् Kām. 19. 60; said to be Atm. when the object is some limb of one's own body; आहते शिरः; but cf. आजघ्ने विषमविलोचनस्य वक्षः Ki. 17. 63; so आहध्वं मा रघूत्तमं; Bk. 8. 15, 5. 102 (see Sk. on P. I. 3. 28 also). --2 To strike, ring, beat (as a bell, drum &c.); Bk. 1. 27, 17. 7, Me. 66; R. 17. 11. --3 To kill, slaughter.
आहत: आहत p. p. 1 Struck, beaten (as a drum &c.); Ku. 4. 25, 30; R. 4. 23, 12. 77. --2 Trodden; पादाहतं यदुत्थाय मूर्धानमधिरोहति Śi. 2. 46; गजदंताहता वृक्षाः Rām. --3 Injured, killed. --4 Dispelled, destroyed, removed. --5 Multiplied (in Math.); सूर्याब्धिसंख्यया द्वित्रिसागरैरयुताहतैः Sūrya S.; एकैकमब्देषु नवाहतेषु Bṛ. S. 8. 22. --6 Known, understood. --7 Rolled (as dice). --8 Uttered falsely. --तः A drum. --तं 1 A new cloth or garment. --2 An old garment. --3 A nonsensical or meaningless speech, an assertion of impossibility; e. g. एष वंध्यासुतो याति Subhāṣ. --Comp. --लक्षण a. = आहितलक्षण q. v. under आधा.
आहति: आहतिः f. 1 Killing. --2 A blow, hit, striking. --3 Coming (आगति). --4 Multiplication; अंशाहतिच्छेदवधेन भक्ता Līlā.
आहतिः: आहतिः f. 1 Killing. --2 A blow, hit, striking. --3 Coming (आगति). --4 Multiplication; अंशाहतिच्छेदवधेन भक्ता Līlā.
आहनन: आहननं 1 Striking at, beating. --2 A stick.
आहननं: आहननं 1 Striking at, beating. --2 A stick.
आहननीय: आहननीय a. Making oneself known by beating a drum.
आहनस्: आहनस् a. [आ-हन्-असुन्] To be beaten or pressed out (as Soma).
आहव: आहव, आहाव, आहवन &c., See under आहु and आह्वे.
आहवः A sacrifice; तत्र नाभवदसौ महाहवे Śi. 14. 44 (for other meanings see under आह्वे).
आहवः [आहूयंतेऽरयोऽत्र, आ-ह्वे-अप्] 1 Battle, war, fight; एवंविधेनाहवचेष्टितेन R. 7. 67; हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे Bg. 1. 31. --2 Challenge, provoking, calling; °काम्या desire of fighting.
आहिक: आहिकः [अहिरिव, कन् स्वार्थे अण्] 1 The descending node (केतु). --2 An epithet of Pāṇini.
आहिकः: आहिकः [अहिरिव, कन् स्वार्थे अण्] 1 The descending node (केतु). --2 An epithet of Pāṇini.
आहिण्ड्: आहिंड् {c1c} A. To roam about, wander; आहिंड्यते अटव्या अटवीं Ś. 2.
आहिंड्: आहिंड् {c1c} A. To roam about, wander; आहिंड्यते अटव्या अटवीं Ś. 2.
आहिण्डिक: आहिंडिकः A man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣāda father and Vaidehī mother; आहिंडिको निषादेन वैदेह्यामेव जायते Ms. 10. 37; (according to Kull., he was employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, and hence called आहिंडिक).
आहिंडिकः: आहिंडिकः A man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣāda father and Vaidehī mother; आहिंडिको निषादेन वैदेह्यामेव जायते Ms. 10. 37; (according to Kull., he was employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, and hence called आहिंडिक).
आहितुण्डिक: आहितुंडिकः [अहितुंडेन दीव्यति ठक्] A juggler, a snake-catcher, conjurer; अहंखल्वाहितुंडिको जीर्णविषो नाम Mu. 2.
आहितुंडिकः: आहितुंडिकः [अहितुंडेन दीव्यति ठक्] A juggler, a snake-catcher, conjurer; अहंखल्वाहितुंडिको जीर्णविषो नाम Mu. 2.

To be offered as an oblation. --यः A consecrated fire taken from the house-holder's perpetual fire, one of the three fires (i. e. the eastern) burning at a sacrifice; गार्हपत्यादाहवनीयं ज्वलंतमुद्धरेत् । पिता वा एषोऽग्नीनां यद्दक्षिणः पुत्रो गार्हपत्यः पौत्र आहवनीयः Āśval.; see also अग्नित्रेता under अग्नि.
आहवनीयक: आहवनीयक a. Fit for a burnt offering. --कः A consecrated fire.
आहाव: आहावः [आ-हु आधारे घञ्] Fire; see under आह्वे also.
आहावः 1 A trough near a well for watering cattle. --2 War, battle. --3 Invoking, calling.

आहुत: आहुत p. p. Offered to the gods, sacrificed. --तं 1 An offering made to men, hospitality. --2 The nourishment of all created beings (भूतयज्ञ or मनुष्ययज्ञ), regarded as one of the five principal sacrifices of the Hindus; cf. पंचयज्ञ.
आहुति: आहुतिः f. 1 Offering an oblation to a deity, any solemn rite accompanied with oblations; होतुराहुतिसाधनं R. 1. 82. --2 An oblation offered to a deity.
आहुतिः: आहुतिः f. 1 Offering an oblation to a deity, any solemn rite accompanied with oblations; होतुराहुतिसाधनं R. 1. 82. --2 An oblation offered to a deity.
आहुक: आहुकः N. of a prince, grandfather of Kṛṣṇa. --काः N. of a people.
आहुकः: आहुकः N. of a prince, grandfather of Kṛṣṇa. --काः N. of a people.
आहुल्य: आहुल्यं N. of a leguminous shrub; (तगर, तरवट &c.).
आहुल्यं: आहुल्यं N. of a leguminous shrub; (तगर, तरवट &c.).
आहृ: आहृ {c1c} P. 1 To bring, fetch; यदेव वव्रे तदपश्यदाहृतं R. 3. 6; पुष्पं फलं चार्तवमाहरंत्यः 14. 77, 18. 8; प्रतिवाक्यं to bring an answer; वार्तां bring news. --2 To bring near, give; चंद्रगुप्ताय मेदिनीं Kām. 1. 5; अयाचिताहृत Y. 1. 215. --3 To recover, bring back. --4 To obtain, get, receive; Ms. 2. 183, 6. 27, 7. 80, 8. 151, 11. 12; Y. 1. 97. --5 To have, assume; आजह्नतुस्तच्चरणौ… श्रियं Ku. 3. 33. --6 To cause, produce, lead to; बलोपचयं K. 105; प्रीतिं, क्रोधं &c; जनकानां कुले कीर्तिमाहरिष्यति मे सुता Rām. --7 To bring near (as wife), marry; Ku. 6. 28. --8 To wear, put on (as armour &c.); Ki. 1. 35. --9 To offer in a sacrifice, to perform (as a sacrifice); स विश्वजितमाजह्ने R. 4. 86, 14. 87. --10 To take away, attract (as mind). --11 To separate, remove, draw off from. --12 To scare or frighten away, drive forth. --13 To use as food or drink, eat. --14 To speak, say, name, call. --Caus. 1 To make one fetch or bring, cause to give or pay; Ms. 10. 119. --2 To eat. --3 To bring together, collect; Pt. 3. 151. --4 To cause, produce. --5 To exact. --6 To show, exhibit.
आहर: आहर a. (At the end of comp.) Bringing, fetching, taking, seizing; समित्कुशफलाहरैः R. 1. 49. --रः 1 Taking, seizing. --2 Accomplishing, performing. --3 Offering a sacrifice. --4 Drawing in breath, inhaling. --5 The air so inhaled. --6 Inspiration, breath inspired. --Comp. --करटा, --चेला, --निवपा, --निष्किरा, --वसना, --वितना, --सेना compounds of the class called मयूरव्यंसकादि.
आहरण: आहरण a. Taking away, robbing; as in अमृताहरणः. --णं 1 Fetching, bringing (near); समिदाहरणाय प्रस्थिता वयं Ś. 1. --2 Seizing, taking; R. 6. 75. --3 Removing, extracting. --4 Performing, accomplishing (as sacrifice); अश्वमेधस्य कौरव्य चकाराहरणे मतिं Mb. --5 A dowry or present given to a bride (at the time of her marriage); सत्वानुरूपाहरणीकृतश्रीः R. 7. 32. --6 Causing, inducing.
आहर्तृ: आहर्तृ a. 1 One who takes or seizes. --2 Bringing, fetching. --3 Performing; आहर्ता क्रतूनां K. 5. --4 Causing, bringing on; आत्मनो वधमाहर्ता क्वासौ विहगतस्करः V. 5. 1. --m. (--र्ता) A copy-holder (in law).
आहार: आहार a. (रा or री f.) 1 Bringing near, procuring, getting; भाराहारः कार्यवशात् Sk. --2 Going to fetch; अयं गच्छति भर्ता मे फलाहारो महावनं Sāv. 4 23. --रः 1 Taking, fetching, or bringing near. --2 Employing, using. --3 Taking food. --4 Food; (आहरंति रसमस्मादित्याहारः Sk.); °वृत्तिमकरोत् Pt. 1 took his dinner; फलाहार, °वृत्तिः means of livelihood; भैक्षाहारः living on alms; यवाहार, निराहार &c. --Comp. --अर्थिन् a. begging or seeking for food. --निःसरणमार्गः the posterior part, passage of voiding excrements. --पाकः {1} cooking. {2} digestion (of food). --विरहः want of food, privation, starvation. --संभवः the juice of the body, chyle, lymph.
आहारक: आहारक a. Going to fetch or bring; एधानाहारको व्रजति Sk.
आहारिक: आहारिकं (With the Jainas) One of the five bodies belonging to the soul; according to Colebrooke, it is ‘a minute form issuing from the head of a meditative sage to consult an omniscient saint and returning with the desired information.’
आहारिकं: आहारिकं (With the Jainas) One of the five bodies belonging to the soul; according to Colebrooke, it is ‘a minute form issuing from the head of a meditative sage to consult an omniscient saint and returning with the desired information.’
आहार्य: आहार्य pot. p. 1 To be taken or seized. --2 To be fetched or brought near. --3 To be extracted or removed. --4 To be pervaded (व्याप्य). --5 Artificial, adventitious, incidental, external, accessory; आहार्यशोभारहितैरमायैः Bk. 2. 14; न रम्यमाहार्यमपेक्षते गुणं Ki. 4. 23; निसर्गसुभगस्य किमाहार्यकाडंबरेण Malli. on Ku. 7. 20. --6 Purposed, intended (as for instance, the identification or आरोप of उपमान or उपमेय in रूपक of which the speaker is fully cognisant); अयं चंद्रो मुखभित्यादौ चंद्रभिन्ने मुखे चंद्राभेदज्ञानं तच्चाहार्यमेव Tv. --7 Conveyed or effected by decoration or ornamentation, one of the 4 kinds of अभिनय q. v. --8 To be eaten. --9 To be worshipped (as Agni). --र्यः A kind of bandage (बंध). --र्यं 1 Any disease to be treated by means of extracting. --2 Extraction. --3 A vessel. --4 The ornamentative part of the drama, such as dress, decorations &c.
आहेय: आहेय a. [अहेरिदं ढक्] Pertaining to a serpent; Pt. 1. 111.
आहो: आहो ind. An interjection expressing (a) Doubt or alternative (or), and usually standing as a correlative of किं; किं वैखानसं व्रतं निषेवितव्यं… आहो निवत्स्यति समं हरिणांगनाभिः Ś. 1. 27; दारत्यागी भवाम्याहो परस्त्रीस्पर्शपांसुलः Ś. 5. 29. (b) Interrogation. --Comp. --पुरुषिका [ अहोपुरुषवुञ् P. II. 1. 72] {1} great self-conceit or pride; आहोपुरुषिका दर्पाद्या स्यात्संभावनात्मनि Ak.; आहोपुरुषिकां पश्य मम सद्रत्नकांतिभिः Bk. 5. 27. {2} military vaunting, boasting. {3} vaunting of one's own prowess; निजभुजबलाहोपुरुषिकां Bv. 1. 84. --स्वित् ind. a particle implying doubt, ‘or perhaps,’ or may it be &c.’ (corr. of किं); आहोस्वित्प्रसवो ममापचरितैर्विष्टंभितो वीरुधाम् Ś. 5. 9; किं द्विजः पचति आहोस्विद् गच्छति P. VIII. 1. 44 Sk.
आह्न: आह्न a. (ह्नी f.) Daily, performed in a day. --ह्नं [अह्रां समूहः अञ्] A series of days, many days,
आह्निक: आह्निक a. (की f.) [अह्नि भवः, अह्ना निर्वृत्तः साध्यः ठञ्] 1 Daily, diurnal, performed every day or on a day; आह्निकः स्वाध्यायः daily course of study; °आचारः daily observances. --2 Employed or occurring every day (as a teacher, servant, or fever). --कं 1 Any religious rite or duty which is to be performed every day at a fixed hour; अत्राह्निकं सुरश्रेष्ठो जपते Mb. --2 Anything to be performed daily, such as taking meals, bathing &c.; कृताह्निकः संवृत्तः V. 4; समुद्रे कृताह्निकः Mv. 5. --3 Daily food. --4 Daily work or occupation, what may be read on one day. --5 A division of a work (such as that of the Mahābhāṣya).
आह्लाद: आह्लादः Delight, joy; साह्लादं वचनं Pt. 4; °दुघ a. conferring delight.
आह्लादः: आह्लादः Delight, joy; साह्लादं वचनं Pt. 4; °दुघ a. conferring delight.
आह्लादन: आह्लादन a. Giving delight. --नं Gladdening, delighting.
आह्लादिन्: आह्लादिन् a. 1 Delighted, glad. --2 Giving delight, gladdening.
आह्वृ: आह्वृ {c1c} P. Ved. To make crooked, injure.
आहूर्य: आहूर्य a. 1 To be invoked. --2 To be bent down or brought near. --3 To be made favourable.

आह्वे: आह्वे {c1c} P. 1 To call, summon. --2 To invite, invoke (in a liturgical sense). --3 (A.) To provoke, challenge; कृष्णश्चाणूरमाह्वयते Sk.; आह्वत चेदिराण्मुरारिं Śi. 20. 1; Bk. 6. 25, 8. 18, 15. 28, 42, 89. --Caus. 1 To send for, call; कविमाह्वाययामास प्रस्तुतप्रतिपत्तये R. 15. 75; Bk. 6. 121. --2 To cause to invite or summon.
आहूत: आहूत p. p. 1 Called, invoked, invited; यियक्षमाणेनाहूतः पार्थेनाथ द्विषन्मुरम् Śi. 2. 1. --2 Named, called. --तं Calling. --Comp. --प्रपलायिन् m. a defendant or witness not appearing when summoned. --संप्लवः the time of universal destruction.
आह्व: आह्व a. [आ-ह्वे-ड] 1 Who or what calls, a crier. --2 Named, called. --ह्वा [आ-ह्वे-अङ्] 1 Calling, calling out. --2 A name, appellation, oft. at the end of comp.; अमृताह्वः, शताह्वा &c.
आह्वय: आह्वयः 1 A name, appellation (as last member of comp.); काव्यं रामायणाह्वयं Rām.; चक्रसाह्वयं, चरणाह्वयाः; वृद्धेरप्याह्वया इमे Ak. --2 A lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting &c.; (one of the 18 titles of law); पणपूर्वकपक्षिमेषादियोधनं आह्वयः Rāghavānanda on Ms. 8. 7.
